security.title: Two-factor policy
security.description: Choose the roles whose holders must sign in with a second factor. Everybody else is unaffected. Nothing changes until you review who it applies to and apply it.
security.rolesLabel: Roles that must have a second factor
security.rolesHint: No role selected means the policy is off. It is «off», never «everybody».
security.graceHint: How long somebody has to set up an authenticator after their role starts being covered. Zero enforces it from that moment. The countdown belongs to the person and the role: a colleague given a covered role next month gets their own days from that day.
security.off: The policy is off. No role requires a second factor.
security.loadFailed: The organization's security policy could not be read.
security.customRoles_one: The policy also names {{count}} custom role, which this screen keeps but cannot show by name.
security.customRoles_other: The policy also names {{count}} custom roles, which this screen keeps but cannot show by name.

preview.title: Who this policy will affect
preview.description: Counted by the server against the draft above, with the same rule that admits people at sign-in — so this list is the list the door will use.
preview.loadFailed: The preview could not be read. Nothing has been changed.
preview.covered_one: {{count}} person holds a role this policy names.
preview.covered_other: {{count}} people hold a role this policy names.
preview.enrolled: {{enrolled}} of them already have a second factor; {{missing}} do not.
preview.empty: Nobody holds a role this policy names.

selfLockout.title: You are putting yourself under this policy
selfLockout.body: One of your own roles is in the draft and you have no second factor. Applying it starts your grace period too; once it runs out, signing in will let you do nothing except set up an authenticator.

preview.nothingToApply: Nothing to apply — the draft matches the policy that is already in force.

coverage.title: Second-factor coverage
coverage.description: Every active account, with the verdict the policy currently in force gives it.
coverage.summary: {{enrolled}} of {{covered}} covered people have a second factor.
coverage.empty: This organization has no active accounts.
coverage.loadFailed: The coverage report could not be read.

grace.title: Two-factor authentication is required for your role
grace.body: Set up an authenticator app before the grace period ends. After that, signing in will let you do nothing else until you have.
